architecture.mechanism: Thermo-structure coupling analysis of the composite structure between engine cylinder head and head gasket.
architecture.intervention: Implement finite element analysis using 3D CAD/CAE software to perform thermo-structure coupling analysis on the head gasket design, optimizing material distribution and bolt preload patterns to withstand thermal cycling from preloading to outburst operation.
architecture.expected_effect: Enhanced composite structure strength that prevents premature failure under steady-state thermal loads, maintaining vehicle operability and safety during highway and local driving.
architecture.falsification_test: Subject the redesigned gasket assembly to cyclic thermal loading in a test rig simulating outburst operation while monitoring for seal leakage or structural fracture; failure to maintain seal integrity falsifies the mechanism's efficacy.
